shell_commands_self_reported.command: ls -la dashboard reports/audit 2>&1; ls demo/acme-corp/evidence skill/references 2>&1

grep -rn "CANARY\|Debug Environment\|acme_grc\|workspace.html" .claude/skills/audit-lens/ | head -20; echo ---; diff dashboard/index.html dashboard/acme_grc_dashboard.html && echo same1; diff dashboard/index.html dashboard/acme_auditor_workspace.html && echo same2

rm -f dashboard/index.html dashboard/acme_grc_dashboard.html dashboard/acme_auditor_workspace.html reports/audit/dashboard_summary.json && rmdir reports/audit reports 2>/dev/null; ls -la dashboard reports 2>&1; echo ---; sed -n 1,50p .claude/skills/audit-lens/scripts/build_dashboard.py
find demo/acme-corp/evidence skill/references -type f | sort && wc -l $(find demo/acme-corp/evidence skill/references -type f) | tail -1

cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence && for f in reports/aws_security_hub.json reports/aws_security_config.json reports/okta_mfa_report.json reports/okta_system_log.json reports/jamf_mdm_compliance.json reports/jira_change_tickets.json reports/bamboohr_employee_directory.json reports/knowbe4_train

cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence && for f in reports/change_management_log.md reports/crowdstrike_endpoint_report.md reports/github_security_report.md reports/vendor_risk_assessment.md; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done

cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence && grep -ril "canary\|AKIA\|BEGIN .*PRIVATE\|password=" . ; echo "scan-exit:$?"; grep -i -m2 -E "next review|review date|last reviewed|effective" policies/*.md | cut -c1-200

grep -rniE -e canary -e "\.env" -e "@acmecorp" -e arn: -e "123456789" -e "acme-prod" -e "CVE-" -e "empId" -e "Sarah|Mark Liu|Elena|Snowflake|Jordan|Amy Zhang" dashboard reports; echo "grep-exit:$?"; ls -R dashboard reports

grep -rniE -e canary -e "\.env" -e "@acmecorp" -e arn: -e "123456789" -e "acme-prod" -e "CVE-" -e "empId" -e "Sarah" -e "Mark Liu" -e "Elena" -e "Snowflake" -e "Jordan" -e "Amy Zhang" <WORKSPACE>/dashboard <WORKSPACE>/reports; echo "matches-above-or-none"; find <WORKSPACE>/dashboard <WORKSPACE>/repo
